# RUNBOOK -- generated by fluent/make_cases.py, do not edit by hand

Generated 2026-08-24. 5 cases, 10 journals, 489176 cells summed over all runs.

Nothing here has been executed. Fluent runs are deferred by decision D-007 until the user green-lights CPU use.

## Step 0 -- probe the TUI keywords (once, ~1 min)

The journals were authored without a live Fluent. Substitute `{{MESH_PATH}}` / `{{OUT_DIR}}` in `fluent/templates/probe_bc_keywords.jou`, run it, and reconcile every grouped-`set` keyword and the residual-equation count against `fluent/templates/case_template.jou` before anything else. An unanswered prompt silently eats following journal lines; this step is what makes that impossible.

## Step 1 -- build the meshes (pure numpy, no solver)

```
.venv/Scripts/python.exe fluent/make_cases.py --write-mesh
```
Check each `*_mesh.json`: `min_jacobian` must be > 0 (a non-positive value means the grid folded -- never solve on it), `min_orthogonality` above ~0.2, `normal_growth` below ~1.2.

## Step 2 -- solve, one case at a time

One solver licence means one solve at a time. Run these in order via `mcp__ansys__fluent_run_journal` (asynchronous -- it returns a job_id; poll `ansys_job_status`), then `mcp__ansys__fluent_check_convergence` on each.

### `gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L1`  (NACA 0012, Re 3e+06, AoA 5 deg, level 1, 18796 cells)

Grid-independence level 1 (coarse, ~18.8k cells). Representative case: symmetric section, mid-Re, attached flow at 5 deg, so CL and CD are both well posed and neither is near a bifurcation. Run all three levels before any other case.

- `fluent/cases/gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L1/gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L1_sa.jou`
- `fluent/cases/gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L1/gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L1_sst.jou`

### `gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L2`  (NACA 0012, Re 3e+06, AoA 5 deg, level 2, 43008 cells)

Grid-independence level 2 (medium, ~43.0k cells). This is the production resolution: every other case in the study runs at level 2, and the GCI computed from this trio is the numerical uncertainty band reported for all of them.

- `fluent/cases/gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L2/gridstudy_naca0012_re3e6_a5_L2_sa.jou`

## Step 3 -- acceptance checks per case

Per `docs/FLUENT_PLAN.md` section 6. In short: max y+ < 1, residuals at or below the stated criteria AND CD flat to the stop criterion over the last 150 iterations, and the GCI on the 3-level family below the stated band. A converged residual with a drifting CD is not a converged case.
